title: Object Repository screen replacements
description: A non-empty array with one entry per screen, each pairing an existing Object Repository screen with the target app definition file whose application replaces it; the screen keeps its reference ID.

referenceId.description: Reference ID of the Object Repository screen to replace, as printed by create-screen or get-screens.

definitionFilePath.description: Absolute path of the target app definition file to replace the screen with, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.
